title: linear fetch_labels
description: One record per Linear issue label, workspace-level and team-level. The payload is the connector's LabelNode re-encoded, so every key is always present and nothing else is.

color.description: Label colour as a hex string, such as #5e6ad2.

description.description: Label description. Empty string when unset.

createdAt.description: When the label was created. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

updatedAt.description: When the label last changed. Also the DataDate. The Go zero time 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z when Linear returned none.

archivedAt.description: When the entity was archived, or null.

team.description: The owning team, or null for a workspace-level label.
